author: nottherealtar
install_msg: `/blackjack` to sit at the Café Dealer's table. Hit, Stand, Double buttons. `/blackjack stats` for your record. Cog package name is **cafeblackjack**.
name: cafeblackjack
short: Button blackjack vs the Café Dealer
description: Interactive blackjack with Hit/Stand/Double/New Hand buttons. Soft aces, dealer stands on 17, natural blackjack messaging. Per-guild win/loss/push stats. No real currency. Package name cafeblackjack avoids clashes with other blackjack cogs.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-member blackjack wins, losses, and pushes in each guild.
